$comment: Owner editorial approval ledger (Issue #506). One record per change set of public Japanese copy that a review was prepared for. The gate (scripts/check-copy-editorial-approval.mjs) matches a record to the change set by fingerprint, so an approval cannot be reused for different text. The editing aid's output is evidence, never approval: a record only counts when it carries the proposal, the comparison with the original text, AND the owner's decision. Since Issue #720 it must also carry a provenance that names a traceable owner artefact — a record that only says "approved" is reported as awaiting owner confirmation. Since Issue #754 a record whose owner has not decided yet carries `decision: "pending"` and `reviewer: null`: "approved" with the owner's name on it would claim a decision nobody took.
policy: A record is written by the owner after reading the changed Japanese text against its original. The reviewer names the person who decided, the date names when, and `comparisons` names every changed segment the decision covers. Since Issue #720 a record also names its provenance: an approval counts as an owner approval only when a traceable owner artefact backs it. Since Issue #754 the ledger may also carry a record whose owner decision has not been taken yet: such a record says `decision: "pending"` and `reviewer: null` — the reviewer field names the owner's identifier ONLY when the owner actually decided, and an automated side never writes the owner's name there. The procedure is in docs/runbook/copy-editorial-approval.md and the audit of the shipped records is in docs/verification/governance/approval-provenance.md.

record_shape.pr: the pull request number the record belongs to
record_shape.base: the base ref the change set was diffed against
record_shape.reviewer: who decided — the owner's identifier, written ONLY when the owner actually decided. A record an automated side wrote (or a record whose owner decision is still `pending`) carries `reviewer: null`: the owner has not decided, so no owner may be named.
record_shape.reviewedAt: YYYY-MM-DD, when the decision was taken
record_shape.decision: approved | rejected | pending — `pending` means the owner has not decided yet (the record was written by an automated side); it is never approval
record_shape.fingerprint: sha256:… — the change set fingerprint printed by `pnpm run copy:approval:check -- --print-fingerprint`
record_shape.proposal: what the editing aid proposed and how its suggestions were adjudicated (`ran`, `summary`, `disposition`). `ran` records that the tool was run, not how many suggestions it produced: a change with no suggestions is still `ran: true`.
record_shape.comparisons: one entry per changed segment (`path`, `before`, `after`, `verdict` = equivalent | intentional, `note`)
record_shape.provenance: the provenance of the decision (Issue #720). `kind` is owner-review | agent-recorded | unverified; `reference` is a traceable owner artefact (a GitHub review / issue comment URL) or null; `recordedBy` names who wrote the record; `ownerConfirmation` is confirmed | unconfirmed. Only kind=owner-review with a reference and ownerConfirmation=confirmed counts as an owner approval — a record an automated side wrote is evidence that a review was prepared, never that the owner approved it. `evidence` lists what was checked when the classification was made.

proposal.disposition: 提案 0 件。編集補助の出力は「変更を要する提案なし」という証拠として残す。owner 側の判断として 20 セグメントを原文と突き合わせて独立に確認した: (1) データ送信の主張は consent.ts の解決条件 (保存値が granted かつブラウザの off-switch が無い場合だけ granted) と GoogleAnalytics.tsx の mount 条件に一致し、許可前に gtag の loader も route tracker も描画されないこと、(2) 否定 (許可していないあいだは何も送信されない / 拒否しても表示と操作は変わらない) が実際の分岐に対応すること、(3) 広告用途の保存を無効とする文言が Consent Mode の既定 (ad_storage / ad_user_data / ad_personalization が denied) に裏付けられること、(4) DNT / GPC が保存済みの granted を上書きすること、(5) storage 障害の文言が実在する分岐 (書き込み失敗 / 読み取り失敗) に対応すること。いずれも原文と同じ意味を保ち、意図的な追加なので verdict は intentional。参照元とブラウザ・端末の情報が GA4 側に届くという記述は、privacy registry が「本プラットフォームのコードが送信する値」と定義している範囲より広い表現であるため、registry との文言整合を owner が判断する follow-up として別途記録する (本 PR の差し替えではない)。
